name: 龔宇睿
objective:
This course is designed specifically for students with an engineering background. It covers unit conversions and significant figures, atomic structure of elements, chemical equation equilibrium and calculations, heat of reaction, gases and their laws, the atmosphere and environmental pollution, the periodic table, chemical bonds, molecular structure of compounds, thermodynamics, kinetics, reaction mechanisms, equilibrium constants, oxidation and reduction, acid-base reactions, electrochemistry, separation of mixtures, and modern technological materials, laying a solid foundation in chemistry.
本課程專為工程專業背景的學生設計。其課程介紹單位換算與有效數位，元素的原子結構、化學方程式平衡與計算，反應熱，氣體與氣體定律，大氣層與環境污染，週期表，化學鍵，化合物的分子結構，熱力學，動力學，反應機構，平衡常數，氧化與還原，酸鹼反應，電化學，混合物的分離及現代科技材料，以奠定良好化學基礎。
